source: User approval in NAS conversation on 2026-11-11
objective: Minimize total unique trainable parameters while matching or beating the original baseline mean dev answer-token CE; confirm non-worse held-out test loss on fresh paired seeds before including the result in a tweet.
candidate_parameter_constraint: Total unique trainable parameter count, including embeddings and learned scalars, must be strictly below 27144960. Individual components may increase in size.

fixed_training.data: Same tokenizer, train/dev/test splits, packing, batch size and batch order per paired seed
fixed_training.recipe: Same optimizer, learning-rate schedule, regularization, precision and initialization policy
fixed_training.evaluation: Same answer-token CE, evaluation frequency and checkpoint-selection rule

allowed_architecture_changes: Layer loops with optional reinjection of the original layer input
GELU, ReLU, squared ReLU, SiLU, or tanh-approximate GELU activations
Increase or decrease individual FFN hidden widths
Fixed or learned residual branch scalars, with matched initial values for fixed/learned comparisons
Reorder and repeat sublayers, including FFN followed by FFN followed by attention
Increase or decrease number of layers
Increase or decrease embedding/residual model dimension with compatible attention dimensions
parameter_allocation_rule: Individual components may increase in parameter count, including adding layers or widening parts. Other reductions must more than offset those increases: total unique trainable parameters, including embeddings and learned scalars, must be strictly below the 27,144,960-parameter baseline.

mandatory_logging.architecture_registry: Record every architecture tried with a unique ID, canonical specification/hash, parent/edit history, and total parameter count.
mandatory_logging.run_registry: Record every attempted run with a unique run ID, architecture ID, seed, full training configuration and source/data hashes, host, physical GPU, UTC start/end, step count, elapsed time, and status/error details.
mandatory_logging.metrics: Retain training-loss and dev-loss curves, best-dev checkpoint/step, parameter count, and final held-out test scores when evaluated.
mandatory_logging.coverage: Retain completed, failed, interrupted and rejected attempts. Never omit unfavorable results.
mandatory_logging.relationship: Each run links to exactly one architecture specification; multiple seeds and GPU assignments are separately recorded.
mandatory_logging.execution: Maintain logs on the compute server so recording continues without dependence on the laptop.

run_authorization: User explicitly instructed starting this goal now and final results by 10:30 PM Pacific.
